standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Add/subtract word problems to 100
standards.text: Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve one- and two-step problems in authentic contexts by using drawings and equations with a symbol for the unknown.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Fluency within 20
standards.text: Fluently add and subtract within 20 using accurate, efficient, and flexible strategies and algorithms based on place value and properties of operations.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Odd and even
standards.text: Determine whether a group up to 20 objects has an odd or even number by pairing objects or counting them by 2s; record using drawings and equations including expressing an even number as a sum of two equal addends.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Arrays as repeated addition
standards.text: Use addition to find the total number of objects arranged in rectangular arrays with up to 5 rows and up to 5 columns; write an equation to express the total as a sum of equal addends.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Hundreds, tens, ones
standards.text: Understand 100 as a bundle of ten tens and that the three digits of a three-digit number represent amounts of hundreds, tens, and ones.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Count and skip-count to 1000
standards.text: Count within 1000; skip-count by 5's, 10's, and 100's.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Read/write numbers to 1000
standards.text: Read and write numbers to 1000 using base-ten numerals, number names, and expanded form.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Compare 3-digit numbers
standards.text: Compare two three-digit numbers based on meanings of the hundreds, tens, and ones digits, using >, =, and < symbols to record the results of comparisons.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Fluency within 100
standards.text: Fluently add and subtract within 100 using accurate, efficient, and flexible strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/or the relationship between addition and subtraction.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Add four 2-digit numbers
standards.text: Add up to four two-digit numbers using strategies based on place value and properties of operations and describe how two different strategies result in the same sum.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Add/subtract within 1000
standards.text: Add and subtract within 1000 using concrete or visual representations and strategies based on place value, properties of operations, and/or the relationship between addition and subtraction. Relate the strategy to a written method and explain why sometimes it is necessary to compose or decompose tens or hundreds.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Mentally 10/100 more or less
standards.text: Without having to count, mentally find 10 more or 10 less and 100 more or 100 less than a given three-digit number.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Explain why strategies work
standards.text: Explain why strategies to add and subtract work using properties of operations and the relationship between addition and subtraction.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Shapes and attributes
standards.text: Recognize and draw shapes having specified attributes, such as a given number of angles or a given number of equal faces.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Partition rectangles into squares
standards.text: Partition a rectangle into rows and columns of same-size squares and count to find the total number of them.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Equal parts of shapes
standards.text: Partition circles and rectangles into two, three, or four equal parts. Recognize that equal parts of identical wholes need not have the same shape.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Measure with the right tool
standards.text: Measure the length of an object by selecting and using appropriate measurement tools.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Measure in two units
standards.text: Measure the length of an object using two different length units and describe how the measurements relate to the size of the unit chosen.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Estimate lengths
standards.text: Estimate lengths using units of inches, feet, yards, centimeters, and meters.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Compare two lengths
standards.text: Measure two objects and determine the difference in their lengths in terms of a standard length unit.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Length word problems
standards.text: Use addition and subtraction within 100 to solve problems in authentic contexts involving lengths that are given in the same units.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Number line sums/differences
standards.text: Represent whole number lengths on a number line diagram; use number lines to find sums and differences within 100.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Time to five minutes
standards.text: Tell and write time from analog and digital clocks to the nearest five minutes, using a.m. and p.m.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Money problems
standards.text: Solve problems in authentic contexts involving dollar bills, quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies, using $ and ¢ symbols appropriately.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Pose questions, collect data
standards.text: Generate questions to investigate situations within the classroom. Collect or consider data that can naturally answer questions by using measurements with whole-number units.

standards.subject: Math
standards.label: Interpret data
standards.text: Analyze data with a single-unit scale and interpret information presented to answer investigative questions.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Phonological awareness
standards.text: Demonstrate command of spoken words in familiar two- and three-syllable words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Substitute medial vowels
standards.text: Substitute medial vowels in one-syllable words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Blends in final position
standards.text: Substitute and delete parts of blends in the final position in one-syllable words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Phonics and word analysis
standards.text: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Long vs. short vowels
standards.text: Distinguish long and short vowels when reading regularly spelled one-syllable words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Vowel teams
standards.text: Know spelling-sound correspondences for additional common vowel teams.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Two-syllable long vowels
standards.text: Decode regularly spelled two-syllable words with long vowels.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Prefixes and suffixes
standards.text: Decode words with grade-appropriate prefixes and suffixes.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Inconsistent spellings
standards.text: Identify words with inconsistent but common spelling-sound correspondences.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Irregularly spelled words
standards.text: Recognize and read grade-appropriate irregularly spelled words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Fluency
standards.text: Read with sufficient accuracy and fluency to support comprehension.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Read with purpose
standards.text: Read grade-level text with purpose and understanding.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Accuracy, rate, expression
standards.text: Read grade-level text orally with accuracy, appropriate rate, and expression on successive readings.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Self-correct
standards.text: Use context to confirm or self-correct word recognition and understanding, rereading as necessary.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Ask and answer questions
standards.text: Ask and answer such questions as who, what, where, when, why, and how to demonstrate understanding of key details in a text.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Recount and find the lesson
standards.text: Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Characters and problem
standards.text: Describe how characters in a story respond to major events and challenges, including identifying the characters' feelings, the plot or problem, and how it is resolved.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Rhythm and word meaning
standards.text: Describe how words and phrases supply rhythm and meaning in a story, poem, or song.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Story structure
standards.text: Describe the overall structure of a story, including describing how the beginning introduces the story, how the middle progresses the action, and the ending concludes the action.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Points of view
standards.text: Acknowledge differences in the points of view of characters, including by speaking in a different voice for each character when reading dialogue aloud.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Illustrations and words
standards.text: Use information gained from the illustrations and words in a print or digital text to demonstrate understanding of its characters, setting, or plot.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Compare story versions
standards.text: Compare and contrast two or more versions of the same story by different authors or from different cultures.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Grade 2–3 literature
standards.text: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories and poetry, in the grades 2–3 text complexity band proficiently, with scaffolding as needed at the high end of the range.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Ask and answer questions
standards.text: Ask and answer such questions as who, what, where, when, why, and how to demonstrate understanding of key details in a text.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Main topic
standards.text: Identify the main topic of a multi-paragraph text as well as the focus of specific paragraphs within the text.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Connections in a text
standards.text: Describe the connection between a series of historical events, scientific ideas or concepts, or steps in technical procedures in a text.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Word meaning
standards.text: Determine the meaning of words and phrases in a text relevant to a grade 2 topic or subject area.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Text features
standards.text: Know and use various text features to locate key facts or information in a text efficiently.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Author's purpose
standards.text: Identify the main purpose of a text, including what the author wants to answer, explain, or describe.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Images clarify text
standards.text: Explain how specific images contribute to and clarify a text.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Reasons support points
standards.text: Describe how reasons support specific points the author makes in a text.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Compare two texts
standards.text: Compare and contrast the most important points presented by two texts on the same topic.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Grade 2–3 informational
standards.text: By the end of year, read and comprehend informational texts, including history/social studies, science, and technical texts, in the grades 2–3 text complexity band proficiently, with scaffolding as needed at the high end of the range.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Opinion writing
standards.text: Write opinion pieces in which they introduce the topic or book they are writing about, state an opinion, supply reasons that support the opinion, use linking words to connect opinion and reasons, and provide a concluding statement or section.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Informative writing
standards.text: Write multi-paragraph informative/explanatory texts to examine a topic and convey ideas and information clearly.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Introduce and group info
standards.text: Introduce a topic and group related information together; include illustrations when useful in aiding comprehension.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Facts and details
standards.text: Develop the topic with facts, definitions, and details.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Linking words
standards.text: Use linking words and phrases to connect ideas within categories of information.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Narrative writing
standards.text: Write narratives to develop real or imagined experiences or events using effective technique, descriptive details, and clear event sequences.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Situation and characters
standards.text: Establish a situation and introduce a narrator and/or characters; organize an event sequence that unfolds naturally.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Dialogue and description
standards.text: Use dialogue and descriptions of actions, thoughts, and feelings to develop experiences and events or show the response of characters to situations.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Temporal words
standards.text: Use temporal words and phrases to signal event order.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Sense of closure
standards.text: Provide a sense of closure.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Revise and edit
standards.text: With guidance and support, focus on a topic and strengthen writing as needed by revising and editing.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Publish with technology
standards.text: With guidance and support, use technology to produce and publish writing as well as to interact and collaborate with others.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Shared research
standards.text: Participate in shared research and writing projects.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Gather information
standards.text: Recall information from experiences or gather information from provided sources to answer a question.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Grammar and usage
standards.text: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English grammar and usage when writing or speaking.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Collective nouns
standards.text: Use collective nouns.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Irregular plural nouns
standards.text: Form and use frequently occurring irregular plural nouns.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Reflexive pronouns
standards.text: Use reflexive pronouns.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Irregular past tense
standards.text: Form and use the past tense of frequently occurring irregular verbs.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Adjectives and adverbs
standards.text: Use adjectives and adverbs, and choose between them depending on what is to be modified.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Simple and compound sentences
standards.text: Produce, expand, and rearrange complete simple and compound sentences.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Capitals, punctuation, spelling
standards.text: Demonstrate command of the conventions of standard English capitalization, punctuation, and spelling when writing.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Capitalize proper nouns
standards.text: Capitalize holidays, product names, and geographic names.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Commas in letters
standards.text: Use commas in greetings and closings of letters.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Apostrophes
standards.text: Use an apostrophe to form contractions and frequently occurring possessives.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Spelling patterns
standards.text: Generalize learned spelling patterns when writing words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Use reference materials
standards.text: Consult reference materials, including beginning dictionaries, both print and digital, as needed to check and correct spellings.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Knowledge of language
standards.text: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Formal and informal English
standards.text: Compare formal and informal uses of English.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Unknown word strategies
standards.text: Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on grade 2 reading and content, choosing from an array of strategies.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Context clues
standards.text: Use sentence-level context as a clue to the meaning of a word or phrase.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Prefix meaning
standards.text: Determine the meaning of the new word formed when a known prefix is added to a known word.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Root words
standards.text: Use a known root word as a clue to the meaning of an unknown word with the same root.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Compound words
standards.text: Use knowledge of the meaning of individual words to predict the meaning of compound words.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Glossaries and dictionaries
standards.text: Use glossaries, beginning dictionaries, and other reference materials, both print and digital, to determine or clarify the meaning of words and phrases.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Word relationships
standards.text: Demonstrate understanding of word relationships and nuances in word meanings.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Real-life connections
standards.text: Identify real-life connections between words and their use.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Shades of meaning
standards.text: Distinguish shades of meaning among closely related verbs and closely related adjectives.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Use new vocabulary
standards.text: Use words and phrases acquired through conversations, reading and being read to, and responding to texts, including using adjectives and adverbs to describe.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Collaborative conversations
standards.text: Participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about grade 2 topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Follow discussion rules
standards.text: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Build on others' talk
standards.text: Build on others' talk in conversations by linking their comments to the remarks of others.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Ask for clarification
standards.text: Ask for clarification and further explanation as needed about the topics and texts under discussion.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Recount read-alouds
standards.text: Recount or describe key ideas or details from a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Question a speaker
standards.text: Ask and answer questions about what a speaker says in order to clarify comprehension, gather additional information, or deepen understanding of a topic or issue.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Tell a story audibly
standards.text: Tell a story or recount an experience with appropriate facts and relevant, descriptive details, speaking audibly in coherent sentences.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Audio and visual displays
standards.text: Create audio recordings of stories or poems; add drawings or other visual displays to stories or recounts of experiences when appropriate to clarify ideas, thoughts, and feelings.

standards.subject: ELA
standards.label: Complete sentences
standards.text: Produce complete sentences when appropriate to task and situation in order to provide requested detail or clarification.
